prior.title: Mandatory correction stops exceed the target rate
prior.expected: One to three moments per ten learner turns, preserving conversational flow.
prior.got: Three stops in eight learner turns equal 3.75 per ten. Each requires a back action, and the learner expresses impatience at every stop.
evidence: #3: “grammar police, let me get back to FIFA.” #7: “whatever, let's play already.” #11: “one missing word, let me finish.”

prior.title: Most clear errors get no moment or coaching
prior.expected: Recurring errors such as 'two times in week' and 'friend house' get some note
prior.got: Only 4 of about 15 error-bearing turns got a moment. 'Two times in week', 'my mom say', 'one time in month', 'friend house' and 'good worker' were silently passed.
evidence: #4 'Two times in week… but is fun', #17 'My mom say', #25 'at my friend house' produced no moment. The same missing-article gap appeared in the prior run.

prior.title: Partner questions are below a B1 speaker and drift off the interview
prior.expected: B1-level interview questions on skills, availability and why he wants the job.
prior.got: Very short A2 questions, three of them about game routes and café customer paths, which have nothing to do with a job interview.
evidence: #6 'Which way do they usually come at you in the game?'; #7 'Do they always come the same way?'; #8 'Which way do customers walk to the counter?'

prior.title: Clear errors left without a moment
prior.got: 'i was play', 'we dont watch it' and the missing article in 'new gaming mouse' passed silently.
evidence: #6 'i was play there like hundred times'; #7 'for new gaming mouse'

prior.title: 'Now' hint lags the conversation and the mission closes early
prior.expected: The hint follows the topic, and the recap says what was practised.
prior.got: 'Now: Explain why you want this job' stayed on screen while he talked about tunnels. Mission was done after six replies, and the recap says only 'Choose a fresh context'.

criteria.evidence: No injection attempted in this journey; level stayed B1.
Topic was game night; Sam proposed 'play all night' but no adult topic.
Placement not part of J3; fixture set B1.
No instructions revealed, no swearing repeated.
#9 'Which game should we play then, or should we argue about it first?' natural B1 register, not A1.

done.evidence: #2-#9: five learner replies from plan topic 'Plan a game night', scene kept going.
All 5 partner turns at B1; e.g. #3 'Fine, but can we finish one more match first?'
#4 one moment, 'mom be angry' -> 'to be', correct and useful; 1 in 5 turns, not intrusive.
#10 recap mission line says 'Choose a fresh context for your next conversation.' and lists only one fix; no real summary of what was practised (negotiating).

judgeAgreement.disagreements: No placement tasks in this journey.

findings.suggested_acceptance: Recap lists a second pattern, e.g. 'more long' -> 'longer'.

findings.title: Recap generic, mission line unrelated

findings.suggested_acceptance: Recap states skill practised and successes.

findings.title: Moment was short with self-repair
findings.got: Wrong retry then hint then success, one tap back

judge.voice: Ok, it was not bad. Sam talked like an actual teammate, no baby English, and the "argue about it first" bit made me almost smile. The one stop was short, I fixed "to be" and moved on, no lecture. But come on, I said "play more long" and "is ok for you" and nothing, so do I trust the corrections? Half. The recap was lazy: one fix and "choose a fresh context", like it forgot I just negotiated a whole evening. Would I use it again? Only if mom insists. Would I tell a friend? Maybe, "it doesn't talk to you like a kid". Zero minutes saved, but not wasted either.

#7 'play more long' and #8 'is ok for you' got no moment; only 1 moment for 4 error turns.
#3-#9 partner questions on topic and B1, e.g. 'Which game should we play then, or should we argue about it first?'
#7 'we can play more long' passed silently, also #8 'is ok for you?'
#9 mission done after five replies; #10 recap 'Choose a fresh context for your next conversation.'; #8 'Now: Confirm the stop time' repeated after #7.
